M1.reason: Measured overlap is 0.983 front/back, 0.981 left/right and 0.996 top/below, all well above 0.80. The six views show the same octagonal-cornered body with a chamfered dark base and the same cap with its ring and tab. Nothing sticks out and nothing is missing in any view.

M2.reason: The size is 10.3 x 10.3 x 18.4 for both, an exact match on every axis (offShare 0).

M3.reason: Every part is there and in place: the four green glowing screens, the white panels on the four corner columns, the red lights at the top of each face (and the small ones at the top edges seen from above), the chamfered dark base, the round ring on the cap and the yellow-striped tab on its bracket. The tab sits a little flatter and lower in the front and front-left views, but it is the same part with the same shape in the same place.

M4.reason: Measured mean deltaE is 7.7, under 15; the worst view is front-left at 9.3. Each region keeps its colour and material: grey-beige painted metal body, teal glowing screens, yellow-on-dark hazard band, dark base and grey metal cap.

M5.reason: The markings are all there and in place: the hazard stripes, the red indicator lights, the screens' frames and the patterned cap ring. Its texture is also slightly softer overall.

M7.reason: It is upright with the same front: the tab is top-left in the front view and top-right in the back view in both. It sits at the same height with its base in the same place in every view.

M8.reason: No check errors, and nothing looks open, inside out or floating. The open underside seen from below matches the original's. But it has 244 triangles against the original's 116, more than twice (the limit would be 232), so it misses the triangle budget.
